title: Internal router_settings_override leaks into the provider request body

assertions.why: internal control field, Anthropic rejects it with 400 Extra inputs are not permitted

observed: A key or team with router_settings plus a callback that sets api_key sends router_settings_override upstream; every request from that key returns 400.
preconditions: virtual key or team with router_settings
callback that sets data["api_key"] in async_pre_call_hook
